claims.head: Daccord is due against the Red Wings
claims.body: Daccord has been shaky against the Red Wings since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.

claims.gist: Don’t read much into Daccord’s record against the Red Wings.

claims.body: The Red Wings’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Kraken’s kill is one of the worst. The Kraken need to stay out of the box.

notes.text: They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 6 of their last 8 games, including the last one. Viktor Arvidsson takes shifts on two lines, L1 and L4. Andreas Englund is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Johansson and Faulk.
J.T. Compher is on injured reserve and has missed the last 6 games.
Simon Edvinsson has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Ben Chiarot has taken his spot beside Moritz Seider.
Brandon Montour is day to day (lower-body injury) and missed their last game. He is a top-four defenseman. Cale Fleury has taken his spot beside Ryker Evans.
Cale Fleury returned in their last game after missing 4 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Vince Dunn has started killing penalties: on the ice for 43% of the team’s shorthanded time in 9 games, up from 2% last season.

SEA.head: The Kraken start a half-step behind
SEA.body: Even though Seattle has home-ice advantage, Detroit has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and gets Perron back. The Kraken’s best way to tip it is keeping dangerous shots away.

DET.head: The Red Wings have a slight edge
DET.body: Even though Seattle has home-ice advantage, Detroit has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and gets Perron back. The Kraken can still swing it if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: DeBrincat’s favorite opponent
paras: The Kraken won the first meeting this season, 6-3 in Detroit. The Kraken are 5-3-1. The Red Wings have won two in a row.
Don’t read much into Daccord’s record against the Red Wings. The Wings’ power play has a soft target in the Kraken’s kill.
